Pong Home tables at the Dill

Whether you’re dropping by for a quick game after work, getting in some serious practice, or playing with friends, Pong Home gives you the flexibility to play your way. Book a table by the hour and enjoy a dedicated space without the commitment of a traditional club membership.

A space made for table tennis

We’ve created a clean, comfortable space where you can focus on your game:

  • 🏓Dedicated table tennis tables for quality play
  • 💡Excellent lighting so you can see the ball clearly
  • 📐Generous playing space to move and play comfortably
  • ⏰Simple hourly booking with flexible time slots
  • 🤖Training-friendly setup for drills, practice, and robot training

No membership. No commitment.

Just book a table, bring your paddle, and play. Whether you’re practicing your serve, working on your footwork, training with a robot, or having a match with friends, Pong Home is ready when you are.
